tests.description: {"en":"Eight questions exploring how you draw energy, take in information, decide, and organize your life.","fr":"Huit questions sur votre énergie, votre perception, vos décisions et votre organisation.","ar":"ثمانية أسئلة تستكشف كيف تستمد طاقتك وتستقبل المعلومات وتتخذ قراراتك وتنظم حياتك."}
tests.answer_key: Four dimensions, one per question pair. Q1+Q5: first option = Extraversion (E), second = Introversion (I). Q2+Q6: first = Sensing (S), second = Intuition (N). Q3+Q7: first = Thinking (T), second = Feeling (F). Q4+Q8: first = Judging (J), second = Perceiving (P). Combine the four majority letters into a type code (e.g. ENFP). If a pair splits 1-1, name the lean and note it is close.
tests.ai_prompt: Write a warm, respectful personality report of 350-500 words. Open with the four-letter pattern and a one-line headline. Cover: how this person recharges, how they process and decide, strengths, blind spots, and two practical suggestions for work and relationships. Never present this as a medical or clinical diagnosis; close by saying it is a self-discovery snapshot, not a diagnosis.

tests.ai_prompt: Write a supportive emotional-intelligence report of 300-450 words. Respectful, non-clinical tone; state clearly this is not a diagnosis.

Not a diagnosis; if the band is the highest, kindly suggest talking with a counselor.

tests.answer_key: Score Rarely=0, Sometimes=1, Often=2, Almost always=3. Total 0-18. 0-4 = minimal signs; 5-9 = mild; 10-14 = moderate; 15-18 = pronounced. tests.ai_prompt: Write a careful anxiety-screening summary of 300-400 words. One-line headline, what the pattern suggests per the band in the key, normalizing language (many people feel this), two grounding practices for this week, and — for the moderate and pronounced bands — a warm recommendation to book a counselor session. State explicitly: this screening is not a diagnosis.
